$comment: Entry schema for contributes.settingsPages (process plugins only, manifest apiVersion 2). Host validation lives in backend/plugin/contrib_settings_pages.go; the CLI mirrors it in tools/mincode-cli/settings_pages.go. A plugin declares at most one page. view is one of this plugin's contributes.views and must not be a floating view; the host embeds it under Settings > Plugins > (plugin name) in the sandboxed plugin UI iframe with the host context surface "settings" (older transport.js versions fall back to "workspace"), no file drop and no warm pool. The host renders a header outside the frame that names the plugin and its ID; the plugin cannot remove, cover or change it. title defaults to the view title. A settings page gives the plugin no new data and no access to MinCode settings (reading or writing host settings, adding to other settings sections and more than one page per plugin are not offered).
description: Settings page: one of this plugin's views shown in Settings > Plugins next to the host-rendered configuration form.

view.description: One of this plugin's contributes.views ids (not a floating view).

title.description: Single-line page title; defaults to the view title.
